metadata.description: Revizto Blueprints — MCP blueprints, Claude plugins and tools for Revizto: live project intelligence and clash governance over the Revizto MCP Server, plus curated Revizto platform skills.

plugins.name: revizto-project-intelligence
plugins.description: Live project intelligence, read-only by default over the Revizto MCP Server — a six-view Cowork dashboard plus the curated Revizto platform skills. Discovers the installing user's own licence and project at runtime; headline totals are exact, sampled detail is always labelled.

plugins.name: revizto-project-intelligence-matrix
plugins.description: Clash governance for Revizto — build clash tests from your project's search sets or the Codifying Coordination v2.0 template, export them for Revizto to import, and, with the Revizto MCP connector, check how they are running in a live project. Works offline; live reads are optional and read-only.
